meta.title: Primordial Paradox music recipes, Baroque and Classical family
meta.citation_note: Every recipe cites source ids from knowledge/music-styles/classical.md section 13. Full titles, URLs and read dates live there, not here, because this directory is scanned by the project's clean-room gate.
meta.chip: NES 2A03 (2 pulse, triangle, noise, DPCM) plus Konami VRC6 (2 pulse, saw)
meta.reference_rule: study only; no melody transcribed, copied or sampled; public domain editions measured as statistics only

measured_anchors.note: all from the corpus statistics file cited as C1 in the study; tempi are the typesetters' playback values, not historical performance tempi

recipes.name: Two voice invention exposition
recipes.when_to_use: The backbone of any town, menu or library cue. Two pulses, one subject, one answer, no third voice needed.
forbidden: both pulses in the same rhythm for a whole bar
parallel perfect fifths or octaves between the pulses
a subject wider than a ninth, which makes the answer uninvertible
pulse 2 at the same duty as pulse 1

recipes.name: Answer at the fifth, delayed one bar
recipes.when_to_use: The moment the second voice enters in a Baroque cue, so the ear hears an answer and not an echo.
forbidden: an answer transposed to an unrelated key
delaying every entry by ear, because only the first one sounds intentional
an answer that starts on the same pitch as the subject's last note held by the other pulse

recipes.name: Episode of one to two bars by sequence
recipes.when_to_use: Between subject entries, to reach the dominant or the relative major without a modulation chord.
forbidden: changing the interval distance inside one sequence
more than three segments
forward then backward motion inside one episode

recipes.name: Half cadence before the final entry
recipes.when_to_use: Two bars before the subject returns for the last time, so the return sounds new.
forbidden: an authentic cadence here, which closes the piece too early
filling the silence with a drum hit

recipes.name: Three voice entry on the VRC6
recipes.when_to_use: Title or ending cue where the expansion chip is already loaded and the texture should feel bigger than the rest of the score.
forbidden: three voices all moving in sixteenths
the saw doubling the melody pitch for pitch, which thickens instead of harmonises

recipes.name: Invention digest for a 16 bar game loop
recipes.when_to_use: A full invention compressed to one loop: subject, answer, two episodes, one return, half cadence at the loop point.

params.plan: subject 0-2, answer 2-4, episode 4-6, subject_relative_major 6-8, episode 8-11, return 11-14, half_cadence 14-16

forbidden: an authentic cadence at bar 16, which makes the loop restart sound like a mistake
a new motif after bar 8

recipes.name: Chaconne ground on the triangle
recipes.when_to_use: Any cue that needs a long variation section over a fixed bass: a castle, a ritual, a slow title bed.
forbidden: changing the ground's rhythm mid piece
putting the ground on a pulse channel, which makes it read as a melody
a ground longer than 4 bars at this tempo

recipes.name: Passacaglia variant, ground in the melody
recipes.when_to_use: The rare case where the repeating figure should be heard as the tune, for a character cue.
forbidden: varying the ground before its third statement, because the pattern has to be learned first
a ground under 2 bars, which reads as a riff

recipes.name: Ground with a waltz bass
recipes.when_to_use: The bridge between the chaconne and the waltz: 3/4, four bar ground, oom pah above it.
forbidden: a drum kit under a chaconne ground
changing the harmonic rhythm inside one statement

recipes.name: Circle of fifths descent as the ground
recipes.when_to_use: The most singable four bar frame in the style; use it when the cue must be remembered after one listen.

params.bar_counts: one chord per bar over 8 bars, or two beats per chord over 4 bars

forbidden: seventh chords on every step, which blurs the fifths motion
starting on a chord other than I or vi if the loop is short

recipes.name: Sequence cell, three statements
recipes.when_to_use: Any rising passage that needs drive without new material: a build to a door opening, a reveal.
forbidden: four or more segments
step of a minor third upward inside a major key without a chord change
ornaments inside the sequenced cell

recipes.name: Ritornello return, partial statement
recipes.when_to_use: A cue with an orchestral feel where the opening material returns shortened, as in a Vivaldi concerto movement.
forbidden: returning the full opening every time, which turns the form into a rondo
returning in a third key

recipes.name: Handel style drive, eighth note engine
recipes.when_to_use: A ceremonial or victory cue that must feel forward moving with no drums.
forbidden: swing or shuffle inside the eighths
legato gate above 90 percent, which smears the drive
noise percussion beyond a single beat 1 hit

recipes.name: Episode over a pedal
recipes.when_to_use: A held triangle note while the two pulses exchange fragments; cheapest possible tension.
forbidden: changing the pedal pitch mid section
both pulses resting at the same time before the pedal resolves

recipes.name: Eight bar period, half then authentic
recipes.when_to_use: The default Classical phrase for court, menu and character cues. Two phrases of four bars.
forbidden: a new theme in the consequent
an authentic cadence at bar 4, which closes the loop early
more than two chords per bar

recipes.name: Sentence, basic idea plus fragmentation
recipes.when_to_use: A cue that must accelerate in feel without changing tempo: a chase, a boss approach.
forbidden: introducing new melodic material after bar 4
halving the note values for more than four bars, which turns to noise at 60 Hz resolution

recipes.name: Minuet, 16 bar binary
recipes.when_to_use: Court, ballroom and formal interior scenes. The most idiomatic use of 3/4 before the waltz arrives.
forbidden: a drum kit
sixteenth note runs in the accompaniment
a tempo above 134 bpm, which makes it a scherzo

recipes.name: Scherzo, two bar cell at 168 to 200
recipes.when_to_use: Battle, chase and comic danger. The minuet turned savage, per Beethoven's use of the form.
forbidden: quarter note accompaniment on beats 2 and 3 at this tempo, which reads as a fast minuet
a phrase longer than 4 bars before the trio

recipes.name: Alberti bass on pulse 2
recipes.when_to_use: Any Classical cue that needs harmonic filling from two channels: lowest, highest, middle, highest, four notes per bar.
forbidden: Alberti under a melody that is also in continuous eighths
using a seventh chord shape, which muddies the pattern
putting the pattern on the same channel as the melody

recipes.name: Cadential 6/4 frame
recipes.when_to_use: The strongest two bar close in the style; the top measured trigram in the corpus.

params.timing: 6/4 half bar, V7 half bar, I one bar

forbidden: using it at every phrase end, which flattens the form
a drum hit on the 6/4, which pre-empts the resolution

recipes.name: Waltz chain, introduction plus five waltzes plus coda
recipes.when_to_use: Ballroom, party and set piece cues, and the title theme's existing 3/4 shape.
forbidden: two waltz numbers in the same key in a row after the third
a coda shorter than 8 bars, which makes the chain end flat
a drum kit under the chain

recipes.name: Oom pah with two pulses
recipes.when_to_use: Every 3/4 dance number. The accompaniment IS the percussion in this style.
forbidden: three notes in the chord on one pulse
the chord louder than the melody
a kick sample on beat 1 in addition to the triangle root

recipes.name: Hemiola across two bars
recipes.when_to_use: The last two bars before a coda, a trio, or a loop return. The largest accent available without a tempo change.
forbidden: holding the hemiola for a whole section
a hemiola on the first bar of a cue, because the 3/4 must be established first

recipes.name: Rubato budget at 60 Hz
recipes.when_to_use: Any waltz or slow movement where the machine timing should stop being audible.
forbidden: a global tempo change inside a loop
rubato on both the melody and the bass, which just sounds like a slower tempo
a 1 frame offset, which is below audibility and only wastes frames

recipes.name: Waltz coda in eight bars
recipes.when_to_use: The ending of any waltz chain, and the model for a staff roll.

params.plan: bars 1-4 fragment the waltz 1 head, bars 5-6 hemiola, bars 7-8 cadential 6/4 to I

forbidden: introducing the waltz 5 climax again here
an unresolved final chord on a cue that is not looping

recipes.name: Cadential trill in frames
recipes.when_to_use: One to two beats before the tonic at a phrase or section close.
forbidden: a trill under 3 frames per note
writing the period high byte mid trill, which resets phase and pops
a trill on both pulses at once

recipes.name: Mordent and turn, frame counts
recipes.when_to_use: Decoration on a phrase opening or on the last long note of a strain, on the repeat only.
forbidden: a mordent on a note shorter than 6 frames
a turn inside a running passage
two ornaments in the same two bars

recipes.name: Long appoggiatura resolving on the beat
recipes.when_to_use: One per section, on the strongest beat, where the style wants yearning: a sad cue or a cadence.
forbidden: an appoggiatura that does not resolve
an appoggiatura on a weak beat, which is a passing tone and should be written as one
an appoggiatura on the root at a final cadence, which blurs the arrival

recipes.name: Classical hook in eight bars
recipes.when_to_use: Every cue that must be remembered: the theme statement itself, before any development.
forbidden: a hook that starts after bar 2
a hook wider than a tenth
an authentic cadence inside the hook, which ends the memory before it forms
ornaments inside the hook's first statement

recipes.name: Human touch bundle for this style
recipes.when_to_use: Applied on top of any recipe in this file, once, at the end of arrangement.
forbidden: vibrato from the attack
gate at 100 percent for a whole cue
the same volume on every channel
any of these applied inside the first statement of the hook
